summary: The candidate is valid test-only hardening for a production fix already present in the recorded base. Exact-candidate tests and its gfx950 probe passed, and an independent concurrency-scaling probe confirmed that the removed dense packed-token SDPA path grows quadratically while the current VisionTritonAttention path remains numerically aligned with per-sequence SDPA. Full H100 Kimi-VL serving and MMMU qualification remains unavailable, so the original issue is not claimed fully resolved by this review.

tests.what_was_measured: At exact candidate commit: five focused tests passed plus two subtests covering single-image and uneven packed cumulative boundaries forwarded through MoonVitEncoderLayer to VisionAttention.

At exact candidate commit on gfx950: actual VisionTritonAttention matched independent per-sequence SDPA within 0.0078125; for lengths [1024,1536], reconstructed legacy peak was 261237248 bytes versus 0 allocator-visible intermediate bytes for the current path.

Independent 1/2/4/8-image packed scaling on gfx950. Current output matched per-image SDPA within 0.00390625. Reconstructed pre-fix transient allocation grew from 6440960 to 373568000 bytes, demonstrating the concurrency-dependent quadratic mechanism.

The implementation immediately before the already-landed production fix creates a [1,total_tokens,total_tokens] boolean mask and invokes 3-D PyTorch SDPA; the recorded base is a descendant of fix commit 7dcebca255991e0e357116003e249da6dbfc888b.

gpu_execution_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X with gfx950 ISA; torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015. Repository source imports resolved under /job/repo/python/sglang.
remaining_counterexamples: No NVIDIA H100 was available, so CUDA/Hopper FA3 selection and memory behavior are not directly verified.
Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking-2506 weights and MMMU were unavailable, so the reported full server, concurrency-8 request workload, semantic accuracy, and end-to-end peak memory are not reproduced.
Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned; four-GPU or other distributed behavior remains unverified.
remaining_limitations: The candidate changes only tests and reports; it is not a duplicate production fix.

The recorded base is already post-fix, so failing-before evidence uses the actual pre-fix source plus execution of its reconstructed dense-SDPA algorithm rather than launching the old full model server.
No native files changed and repository-environment.json declares no native artifact, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
